content: SSRF prevention: validate all user-supplied identifiers against a strict allowlist (enum/known set) before building any outbound URL; never interpolate raw user input into a URL; use Node's URL class to parse and check protocol/hostname; prefer allowlists over blocklists; for this project the airport-code allowlist obviates most SSRF surface entirely since outbound calls are constructed from a validated internal registry, not raw user text.
